title: asn2wrs: Include epan/asn1.h if a non-empty export header is included
description:
Most (though not all) of the generated ASN.1 export headers require
epan/asn1.h (or at least asn1_ctx_t).

If we're creating an ASN.1 dissector header file, and include a
non-empty export header, and epan/asn1.h hasn't been included yet,
include it. This does include it sometimes when not necessary, but
helps ensure that shipped headers can be preprocessed.

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

During Debian/Ubuntu dpkg-buildpackage I see following issues

```
debian/libwireshark-dev/usr/include/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-kerberos.h:57:26: error: unknown type name ‘asn1_ctx_t’
   57 | kerberos_is_win2k_pkinit(asn1_ctx_t *actx);
etc...
```

Seems the location where the asn2wrs script finds are not good as there is a bunch of `asn1_ctx_t` above

It build fine out-of-directory otherwise on Ubuntu

ubuntu PPA  builder not happy too ?
https://launchpadlibrarian.net/849313097/buildlog_ubuntu-resolute-amd64.wireshark_4.7.0-0~202602252041~ubuntu26.04.1_BUILDING.txt.gz
!23709 should handle both of those issues. For some reason packet-oer.h never included epan/asn1.h (it's not a generated dissector.)
Ubuntu PPA build is resolved too
